mapper.sql: p.pairing_id, p.member_id, p.coffee_log_id, p.music_log_id, c.bean_name, c.brew_method, c.drink_date, m.track_name, m.artist_name, m.album_name, m.listened_date, p.mood_summary, p.mood_tags, p.pairing_score, p.pairing_text, p.ai_reason, p.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pairing p JOIN coffee_log c ON c.coffee_log_id = p.coffee_log_id JOIN music_log m ON m.music_log_id = p.music_log_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.pairing_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM pairing p JOIN coffee_log c ON c.coffee_log_id = p.coffee_log_id JOIN music_log m ON m.music_log_id = p.music_log_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.pairing_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 'coffee' AS item_type, c.coffee_log_id AS item_id, c.drink_date AS recorded_date, c.bean_name AS title, CONCAT(c.brew_method, ' · ', COALESCE(c.memo, '')) AS description, CONCAT('no. ', LPAD(c.coffee_log_id, 3, '0')) AS catalog_no FROM coffee_log c WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT 'music' AS item_type, m.music_log_id AS item_id, m.listened_date AS recorded_date, CONCAT(m.artist_name, ' — ', m.track_name) AS title, CONCAT(m.genre, ' · ', COALESCE(m.memo, '')) AS description, CONCAT('no. ', LPAD(m.music_log_id, 3, '0')) AS catalog_no FROM music_log m WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY recorded_date DESC, item_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
